notes: SAS SQL solution: DATA step (cards4, 6 rows level/id/color) + PROC SQL grouping by color with count(distinct id) as ids, sum(level) as most_important, count(*) as records. Only change from upstream: libname sd1 'd:/sd1' dropped in favour of WORK so the bundle is self-contained; the cards4 data and PROC SQL query are byte-identical to upstream. Added a PROC PRINT to render the WANT table the author documents. R/Python/dplyr blocks (%utl_rbeginx/%utl_pybeginx) shell out to external interpreters via the author's personal utl macros and are not SAS-testable in isolation.
